orientation.why: Which parts of the result belong to the reference emulator, the partial board model and the physical phone?
orientation.open: A result needs a build, an environment and an observable acceptance condition.

three-machines.why: What state crosses from the loader into the original kernel?
three-machines.open: The reference icon grid cannot establish the native board’s peripheral behavior.

boot-handoff.why: How do the runtime properties describe that machine state?
boot-handoff.open: The entry PC is one receipt. Check the first successfully completed kernel boundary separately.

device-tree.why: Which CPU semantics remain implicit in the original code?
device-tree.open: The archived tree alone does not establish the live handoff values.

cpu-compatibility.why: What happens when an otherwise valid instruction accesses a mapped page?
cpu-compatibility.open: The observed SWP cases leave atomicity, copy-on-write and fault behavior open.

mmu-and-caches.why: Once memory is observable, what drives forward progress?
mmu-and-caches.open: A descriptor walk and a physical cache-maintenance receipt answer different questions.

time-and-interrupts.why: How do working interrupts become discoverable services?
time-and-interrupts.open: Later registration must preserve the callback route already shown to return.

iokit-discovery.why: How does a discovered storage service return a completed request?
iokit-discovery.open: Class registration proves discovery; a valid GPT control establishes additional reads.

storage-abi.why: When may the correctly encoded completion execute?
storage-abi.open: Synthetic register placement is useful only if the integrated caller uses the same convention.

async-storage.why: Did the completed requests leave a consistent volume?
async-storage.open: Deferred completion removes stack growth; persistence and filesystem integrity need their own receipts.

hfs-integrity.why: What new service contracts appear when graphical clients begin?
hfs-integrity.open: Mount return, BOOT_TIME, checked writes and clean reboot are separate milestones.

graphics-stack.why: Which allocation owns the pixels that the client just rendered?
graphics-stack.open: The next comparison needs the selected client surface and the eventual scanout in the same run.

surface-memory.why: How do the selected bytes reach a visible scanout?
surface-memory.open: A default surface can retain a logo while a different surface contains setup imagery.

presentation.why: Is a later black frame a failure or an intentional submission?
presentation.open: Physical signatures and human observation support different parts of the display claim.

display-blanking.why: Which event path can wake an intentionally blanked display?
display-blanking.open: A null presentation and retained backing must be interpreted alongside the dimming caller.

hid-dependencies.why: Can a physical edge traverse the now-ready HID path?
hid-dependencies.open: Removing one readiness wait does not establish delivery from every input device.

buttons.why: Why can a working button path coexist with missing touch?
buttons.open: The observed Power and volume-to-Home mappings do not establish an absolute touch queue.

touch.why: How can another service affect readiness before useful output exists?
touch.open: Specific physical gestures pass; general keyboard, gesture and app coverage remain open.

audio.why: What does a running media and graphics stack imply about idle power?
audio.open: Device enumeration and mapped streams do not establish audible output or a working sample clock.

power.why: Which of those peripheral assumptions can the emulator actually model?
power.open: Native samples distinguish workload-dependent battery balance; heavy-use endurance, thermal monitoring and suspend remain open.

emulator-fidelity.why: How do we distinguish a model defect from a misleading observer?
emulator-fidelity.open: An unimplemented zero MMIO read can select a plausible but wrong presence branch.

observability.why: Which source release can explain the observed machine behavior?
observability.open: A missing console marker must be checked against independent liveness and integrity receipts.

source-archaeology.why: How should mismatched source and incomplete observations be preserved?
source-archaeology.open: Later source explains concepts but cannot replace the missing matching ARM implementation.

preservation-method.why: How did later physical interaction and Camera records extend the earlier frontier?
preservation-method.open: New findings need new dated evidence rather than silent replacement of the earlier snapshot.

native-iphone.why: What distinguishes sensor capture from an app-visible image?
native-iphone.open: The primary 7E18 workflow is owner accepted; ordinary restart, USB services, networking and broader app coverage retain separate gates.

camera-capture.why: How do captured frames become a visible viewfinder?
camera-capture.open: A VGA transfer does not validate higher-resolution modes or useful exposure.

camera-preview.why: Why are many delivered images never selected?
camera-preview.open: Native delivery, image selection and panel updates count different work.

frame-retirement.why: When has a shutter event produced a durable photograph?
frame-retirement.open: The larger legacy queue now has one physical comparison; broad repetition and 7E18 rate measurement remain pending.

camera-stills.why: Which metric supports a responsiveness claim?
camera-stills.open: 7E18 saves a resampled still and reopens a new photo after cold power-on; higher-detail acquisition and power-loss durability remain open.

measuring-performance.why: How should a new result preserve the earlier evidence?
measuring-performance.open: One OFF/ON pair and an isolated replay do not establish a general speed multiplier.
